In order to strengthen our team at the Sihlstrasse site in Zurich, we are looking for a qualified/n and ready for performance by appointment The Vista Eye Praxes & Clinics are the largest provider of eye medicine in Switzerland with their around 35 locations and about 500 employees. We offer first-class medical services for our patients and set standards in the disciplines of ophthalmology, eye surgery and eye laser medicine. Zurich / ZH Our practice / clinic team ensures a customer-friendly and efficient process of speaking hours. A versatile task awaits you, in which you are competently assisting our patients and actively supporting the doctors. Your tasks
• You welcome and receive our patients
• Support our patients before, during and after medical consultation
• Support for small-scale surgery
• They carry out preliminary examinations such as autorefractometers, facial fields, biometry, corneal topography, endothelial cell measurement, slit lamp photography and subjective refraction for un-ser

• Individual and structured introduction
• A corporate culture in which ideas and suggestions are welcome
